text.en:
Any commodity not included in any previous
Executive Order fixing ceiling prices and issued by authority
of Republic Act No. 509, or in this Order, the size and
specification of which are the same as those of the fore-
going, shall have the same ceiling price.

5894
OFFICIAL GAZETTE

The ceiling prices fixed in this Order include the
seven per cent sales tax.

This Order shall take effect five days from the
date hereof.
Done in the City of Manila, this Sth day of December,
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty, and
of the Independence of the Philippines, the fifth
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
TEODORO EVANGELISTA
Executive Secretary
